sources.title: AI Video Generation Model | LTX
sources.snippet: LTX video generation models are designed for creating and editing video with precision and control. From generating video from text, images, or audio to non-destructive AI video editing, LTX supports scalable workflows for production, post-production, and experimentation. All LTX models share a common design philosophy: composability, predictability, and production readiness.

sources.title: LTX-2: Production-Grade AI Video Generation Model | LTX
sources.snippet: LTX-2 is a pro AI video model for production. It offers precise control, native 4K, high frame rates and proven performance for long-form creative tasks.

sources.title: GitHub - Lightricks/LTX-Video: Official repository for LTX-Video
sources.snippet: Introduction LTX-Video is the first DiT-based video generation model that contains all core capabilities of modern video generation in one model: synchronized audio and video, high fidelity, multiple performance modes, production-ready outputs, API access, and open access.

sources.title: LTX-2 - First Open-Source 4K AI Video Generation Model
sources.snippet: LTX-2 is the first fully open-source 4K AI video generation model with synchronized audio, 50 FPS, and 20-second clips. Based on Lightricks' 19B parameter DiT architecture. Completely free to use!
